# anthropic_agent (Data Source)

Reads the current version of a Managed Agents agent.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_agent" "reviewer" {
  id = "agent_01ExampleAgentId0000000000"
}

output "reviewer_version" {
  value = data.anthropic_agent.reviewer.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Agent id (`agent_...`).

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `mcp_servers` (Attributes List) MCP servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mcp_servers))
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata.
- `model` (String) Model id.
- `model_effort` (String) Reasoning effort.
- `model_inference_geo` (String) Inference geography pin; null when inherited.
- `model_speed` (String) Inference speed.
- `multiagent_json` (String) Resolved coordinator topology as canonical JSON; null when not a coordinator.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `skills` (Attributes List) Skills with their resolved versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skills))
- `system` (String) System prompt.
- `tools_json` (String) Resolved tools configuration as canonical JSON.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Current version.

<a id="nestedatt--mcp_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mcp_servers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Server name.
- `url` (String) Server URL.


<a id="nestedatt--skills"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skills`

Read-Only:

- `skill_id` (String) Skill id.
- `type` (String) `anthropic` or `custom`.
- `version` (String) Resolved version.
